name: Enantiornis
sum: One of the largest enantiornithines, from the Maastrichtian Lecho Formation of Argentina.
wsnote: About 78.5 cm long, 34 cm hip height, 6.75 kg and a wingspan of about 1.2 m (Wikipedia revision cited).
holotype: PVL-4035, a coracoid and proximal scapula from El Brete, Salta.
material: Several isolated bones from the Lecho Formation.
biology: Not given in the sources used.
author: Walker 1981
